name: FCPA & UK Bribery Act Corporate Integrity Compliance
description: Compliance framework for the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA) and UK Bribery Act 2010, covering anti-bribery controls, third-party intermediary due diligence, gift/hospitality tracking, and books & records accuracy.

checklists.name: FCPA & Anti-Bribery Compliance Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for FCPA anti-bribery provisions (15 U.S.C. § 78dd-1) and UK Bribery Act Section 7 adequacy.

items.statement: Anti-bribery policy explicitly prohibits facilitation payments, kickbacks, and improper payments to foreign officials.
Third-party sales intermediaries undergo background screening and execute anti-corruption contract representations.
Gift, travel, and hospitality expenses involving government officials are pre-cleared by Compliance.
Financial ledgers accurately describe all payments and prohibit off-the-books slush funds or false invoices.

reviewGates.name: FCPA Anti-Corruption Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Chief Compliance Officer confirms that third-party due diligence and financial record controls satisfy FCPA and UK Bribery Act requirements.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the anti-bribery audit evidence confirm compliance with FCPA and UK Bribery Act standards?

obligationDefinitions.title: Third-party intermediary due diligence must be refreshed on a recurring cadence
obligationDefinitions.description: FCPA/UK Bribery Act anti-bribery controls require ongoing due diligence on third-party intermediaries (agents, distributors, consultants) with foreign-official exposure; an initial onboarding check does not cover the life of the relationship.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every active third-party intermediary's due diligence is refreshed within its declared cadence.

requiredEvidence.title: Third-party due diligence refresh record
requiredEvidence.description: Due diligence system record showing the refresh date and outcome for each intermediary.

obligationDefinitions.prompt: Has every active third-party intermediary's due diligence been refreshed within its cadence?
